question: The mean absolute deviation of 25, 30, 27, 40 and 35 is:
solution:
**Given:**

Numbers: 25, 30, 27, 40, 35

**Concept:**

The mean absolute deviation (MAD) is the average of the absolute differences between each data point and the mean of the data set.

**Formula Used:**

Mean (x̄) = (Sum of all data points) ÷ (Number of data points)

MAD = (Σ |xᵢ - x̄|) ÷ n

Where:

 
• xᵢ = each data point
 
• x̄ = mean
 
• n = number of data points
